headline: MK (PROP) jumps 14.55% on heavy volume, leading today’s movers
market_take: Across the 232 tickers, property and food stocks led the gains with MK up 14.55% (vol×8.26) and AQUA posting an 11.11% opening gap. Several cons stocks showed solid 5‑10% moves, while a few prop and conmat names recorded sharp gaps or drops, reflecting mixed sentiment. Notable filings include DEMCO’s capital increase, BJCHI’s share repurchase, and TFMAMA’s chairman death, adding corporate‑action focus.

sector_notes.note: MK surged 14.55% with a 6.8σ volume spike and a 12.5% intraday rise, while JCK fell 7.69% on an opening gap; A recorded a -100% price gap, suggesting a possible suspension.
AQUA opened +11.11% and SST posted a 7.37% intraday gain backed by a 3.5σ volume spike; MADAME also showed a 3.8σ volume spike, while XBIO fell 14.3% over five days.
SQ opened +11.11% and DEMCO rose 8.57% on elevated volume; several cons names (STPI, CK, STECON, SEAFCO) added 5‑6% gains.
GEL experienced a -25% opening gap but rebounded with a +33.33% intraday move; PPP and DCON posted intraday moves of -6.33% and +5.56% respectively, and SKN saw a 7.3σ volume spike.
M-PAT climbed 6% on modest volume; CPNCG announced a capital reduction and TTLPF reported a decrease in paid‑up capital, both flagged as high‑impact filings.
TFM recorded a 4.6σ volume spike, highlighting unusual activity in the agribusiness segment.
